2607.26491.title: LLMET: Enabling Cross-Layer Evaluation of Emerging M3D Memories for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
2607.26491.paper_summary: The energy consumption of Large Language Model (LLM) serving is becoming a major system challenge as deployment scales, driven by hardware power and thermal constraints and rising electricity costs. A key contributor to chip energy dissipation is data movement between limited on-chip cache and off-chip High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). Meanwhile, emerging memory technologies such as monolithic 3D (M3D) integration of cache memories at the Back-End-Of-Line (BEOL) of logic chips enable larger and denser on-chip memories, creating new opportunities to reduce costly off-chip traffic. However, it remains unclear whether continuously scaling on-chip memory using emerging technologies can effectively improve the energy efficiency of LLM serving. To address this gap, we develop LLMET (LLM with Emerging Technology), a validated cross-layer simulation framework, and conduct a comprehensive study on the impact of large-capacity on-chip memory technologies across a broad range of models, applications and platforms. Utilizing M3D technology to expand the L2 cache from 40MB to 1GB yields a 44% reduction in chip energy during the Llama3.1-70B prefill phase with a 16K context window, based on LLMET simulation on a dual NVIDIA A100 GPU setup. On the 8x NVIDIA B200-like platform, extending the L2 cache from 128MB to 4GB saves the prefill energy by up to 24%. For the edge platform and workloads, the decode energy saving reaches 30% when increasing the 8MB cache size to 256MB. These results highlight the promise of ultra-large on-chip memories for energy-efficient LLM serving systems.
2607.26491.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）服務的能源消耗正成為隨著部署規模擴大而出現的主要系統挑戰，這是由於硬體功率和熱量限制以及不斷上升的電力成本所驅動。芯片能量耗散的一個主要原因是有限的片上快取與片外高帶寬記憶體（HBM）之間的數據移動。與此同時，像單體三維（M3D）集成的快取記憶體等新興記憶體技術在邏輯芯片的後端（BEOL）使得片上記憶體變得更大且更密集，為減少昂貴的片外流量創造了新的機會。然而，仍然不清楚使用新興技術持續擴展片上記憶體是否能有效提高LLM服務的能源效率。為了填補這一空白，我們開發了LLMET（使用新興技術的LLM），這是一個經過驗證的跨層模擬框架，並對大容量片上記憶體技術在廣泛的模型、應用和平台上的影響進行了全面研究。利用M3D技術將L2快取從40MB擴展到1GB，在16K上下文窗口下，根據在雙NVIDIA A100 GPU設置上的LLMET模擬，Llama3.1-70B的預填充階段芯片能量減少了44%。在8倍NVIDIA B200類平台上，將L2快取從128MB擴展到4GB可將預填充能量節省高達24%。對於邊緣平台和工作負載，當將8MB快取大小增加到256MB時，解碼能量節省達到30%。這些結果突顯了超大片上記憶體在能源高效LLM服務系統中的潛力。
